intro: Los Angeles listings advertise 10x10 units from about $49, while typical non-climate 10x10 street rates run about $270–$277/month, among the highest in the country. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, your six-month average is far above the number on the banner.

units.notes: Walk-in closet; studio overflow. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap). Climate-controlled ~$179–$190.

Most rented size. City average $271 (StorageCafe, Sep 2026), down 5.6% YoY; LA–Long Beach–Anaheim metro averages $249 (Storage Stats), so Orange County and the Valley edges are cheaper. Climate-controlled ~$291–$346.
Two-bedroom contents. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$399.
Three-bedroom home or a car. Climate-controlled ~$501–$571.

local_tips: Neighborhood matters: StorageCafe lists Chesterfield Square (~$124), Eagle Rock (~$179) and Historic South-Central (~$183) as the cheapest areas for a standard unit, while Fairfax (~$494) and Sunkist Park (~$397) are the most expensive.
LA rates tend to be lowest around December and highest in August (StorageCafe).
Asking rents are falling (about 10% lower YoY across the metro per Storage Stats) — a good moment to ask for a lower rate at renewal.
Extra Space charges a $50 admin fee (per StorageUnitCosts), higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
